text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Satsuki Sho, the weather 
was like a storm. Heading to the 
racecourse by taxi, they ended up getting 
stuck in a traffic jam.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was going to be late at this rate. 
Satono Diamond got out of the taxi and 
decided to run to the racecourse on foot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wondered if this situation was due to 
a jinx. However, resolved to shatter any 
jinx in her path, she rallied her spirits 
with fierce determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at the racetrack, the Trainer 
heads for the paddock. It looks like 
Satono Diamond made it in time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it was time to race in the Satsuki 
Sho—!
